beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The protected entry is 'nyanga', but the lesson writes 'inyanga' everywhere (study text and glossary headword), so as a whole word the protected form never occurs and a whole-word guard may not cover 'inyanga'. 'inyanga' is the correct isiZulu form and is not a fault; the protected entry probably needs to name 'inyanga' (or both forms) so the guard actually protects the word the lesson uses.
